# GitHub Actions Workflows

Place executable GitHub Actions workflow YAML files in this directory:

```text
/.github/workflows/
```

Do **not** place executable workflows under `swrlz-core/.github/workflows/`;
GitHub only discovers Actions workflows from the repository-root `.github/workflows/`
directory.

The requested SWRLZ workflow file has intentionally not been invented here. Drop the
known workflow YAML into this directory once recovered from the prior repository.
